description:
Ignite IT is seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to support the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) in developing and modernizing enterprise applications that improve operational efficiency and support critical business functions.
 In this role, you'll join a collaborative Agile engineering team responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure, scalable cloud-native applications. You'll work alongside software engineers, architects, product owners, and stakeholders to deliver modern software solutions that improve enterprise systems and user experiences.
 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working with modern cloud technologies, and delivering high-quality software in a fast-paced Agile environment.
 What You'll Do
 As a member of an Agile Scrum team, you'll design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise software applications supporting CBP systems. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality software while collaborating closely with engineers, architects, product owners, and stakeholders.
 Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications supporting both legacy modernization and new development initiatives. 
 Build scalable backend services using Python, Java, and Spring Boot. 
 Develop responsive, modern user interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, Angular Material, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 Design and consume RESTful APIs within a microservices architecture. 
 Develop applications within Linux containerized environments. 
 Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, testing, demonstrations, and production releases. 
 Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, stakeholders, and end users throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 Enhance existing applications through performance optimization, feature enhancements, and technical modernization. 
 Develop reusable libraries, components, and services that improve maintainability and scalability. 
 Conduct code reviews and promote engineering best practices across the team. 
 Analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions. 
 Help ensure software quality, reliability, and timely delivery. 
 Mentor junior developers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. 
 Continuously evaluate and adopt modern development tools, frameworks, and best practices.
 Requirements 
 Required Qualifications
 U.S. Citizenship. 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a CBP Public Trust. 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience). 
 7+ years of professional software development experience. 
 Experience developing applications within Linux containerized environments. 
 Demonstrated experience with: 
 Python 
 Java 
 Spring Boot 
 Angular 
 TypeScript 
 JavaScript 
 HTML/CSS 
 PostgreSQL 
 AWS 
 Microservices Architecture 
 
 Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs. 
 Strong understanding of Angular development, including Angular Material, component architecture, state management, and UI performance optimization. 
 Experience developing and maintaining Python applications, backend services, APIs, or automation in enterprise environments. 
 Experience integrating Angular frontends with Spring Boot microservices. 
 Experience building Single Page Applications (SPA). 
 Experience creating reusable libraries and responsive user interfaces. 
 Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), and software engineering best practices. 
 Experience using Git and collaborative source control workflows. 
 Working knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including planning, requirements management, development, testing, quality assurance, configuration management, and release management. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. 
 Passion for delivering high-quality, user-centric software solutions.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:
 AWS Certified Developer 
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect 
 Oracle Certified Professional (Java) 
 Kafka or other messaging technologies 
 ETL tools 
 DevOps and CI/CD pipelines 
 Automated testing frameworks 
 Application security best practices 
 UML 
 NGRX or NGXS 
 Enterprise system architecture and distributed systems design
